name: Eventstream as a Business Events Publisher
description: **Eventstream as a Business Events Publisher****Overview**Enable Eventstream to act as a scalable publisher of Business Events—transforming streaming data into structured business signals that can be consumed across Fabric.**Key Capabilities*** Streaming Data as Event Source: Use Eventstream to convert real-time data streams into Business Events aligned with defined schemas.* Schema-Based Event Publishing: Map streaming data to standardized Business Event schemas, ensuring consistency and interoperability across producers and consumers.* Continuous Real-time Event Emission: Publish Business Events continuously from live data streams, enabling downstream systems to react instantly.* Flexible Event Mapping & Transformation: Apply mappings and transformations to enrich raw streaming data into meaningful business-level signals before publishing.* Scalable Publishing Pipeline: Leverage Eventstream’s scale to publish high-volume Business Events reliably across enterprise scenarios.
